meta.title: An awarded event: "Rejected Bids" opens the "Rejected Bids" window

plan.title: Rejected Bids window on awarded event

steps.note: Open the awarded event directly on its RFQ Responses tab.
Open Rejected Bids from the RFQ stage Settings menu without pressing any dialog action.
Verify the Rejected Bids window is open.
Verify the window provides the Close button and remains ready for user action.
